_comment: Issue #81 'The Missing Recruit' (data/quests.json, the_missing_recruit): Recruit Pell's own graph, reached only once present_when (missing_recruit_started) has made this entity structurally exist (skeleton_scene.json's sewers map) -- no talk_pool needed, a bare `conversation` routes every interact straight here. Single option banks the beat-1 counter directly; safe to re-fire (idempotent record_accomplishment, no gold/item on this node) if the player talks to Pell twice before reporting to Dresk.

hub.speaker: Pell
hub.text: Thank the Gods, an actual person. I heard scratching that wasn't rats, then I lost the ladder in the dark, and I've been down here just — you're not going to tell Ashgrave I panicked, are you?

text_variants.text: Made it back fine, thanks to you. Ashgrave's already got me on report-writing duty for it. Fair, honestly.

options.text: Let's get you back to the barracks.
